product_one_liner.value: Dengage is a customer experience data platform that helps marketers unify customer data, orchestrate personalized omnichannel campaigns and measure engagement results.

employee_band.notes: Based on the company's published figure of 170+ employees.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index contains marketing, product-update and company posts, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base contains multiple product guides, including AI Design Studio, AI Text Creation and SmartTag with ZekiAI.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The reviewed current openings list BDR positions and a software engineering internship, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or model provider was publicly identified in the reviewed Zeki AI documentation, security FAQ, blog or subprocessor list; Zeki AI is Dengage's own product-layer name.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a standalone certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 3, 2025; amount was not disclosed. Funding databases disagree on Seed versus Series A, so the stage uses the company's own announcement wording.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 3, 2025 strategic investment falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Business Development Representative—Lebanon posting is dated August 31, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Bounce Watch records a September 22, 2026 launch of Composable AI Marketing Orchestration using Zeki AI. This is a dated secondary report; a dated primary announcement was not located.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mirza Mansoor Baig's profile lists his Dengage VP of Customer Experience role as starting in December 2025.
